site.metaTitle: SwapSpot - Thola Usizo Lwendawo Olwethembekile Eduze Nawe
site.metaDescription: Bhukha abahlinzeki bendawo abathembekile bokuhlanza, ukulungisa, ubuhle, ukunakekela ingadi, ukuthutha, ukunakekela izilwane, ukunakekela abadala, ukufundisa nokunye.
site.hero.body: Bhukha ukuhlanza, ukulungisa, ubuhle, ukunakekela ingadi, usizo lokuthutha, ukunakekela izilwane nokunye emakethe eyodwa yomakhelwane.
site.how.title: Usizo luphakathi kokuthinta okuthathu
site.how.body: Kusukela ku-Ngidinga lokhu kwenziwe kuya ekubhukhweni, ngaphandle kokushaya ucingo kaningi, ukuqagela noma amakhoteshini angacacile.
site.steps.0.1: Bona abahlinzeki bendawo abathembekile kumephu ebukhoma, belandelanisiwe ngebanga nezinga.
site.steps.1.1: Bheka amaphrofayili, amasevisi nentengo ecacile ngaphambi kokuzibophezela.
site.steps.2.1: Thumelana imilayezo, thola ikhoteshini, ukhokhe ngokuphephile ngaphakathi kwe-app.
site.helpers.title: Guqula amakhono akho abe yingeniso yasendaweni
site.helpers.body: Setha kanye bese uqala ukubhukhwa omakhelwane asebevele bedinga ngqo lokho okwenzayo.
site.helpers.freeBody: Gcina u-100% walokho okuholayo. I-SwapSpot ayithathi ikhomishani, iphesenti, noma imali yokuthola amaklayenti.
site.perks.0.1: Bhala amakhono akho, izithombe nendawo yakho yokusebenza ngemizuzu.
site.perks.1.1: Wena ulawula amanani, irediyasi nohlelo lwakho.
site.perks.2.1: Thola izicelo eziseduze uphendule ngamakhoteshini ahlosiwe.
site.perks.3.1: Thola izinga elenza imisebenzi yokuqala ibe amaklayenti avamile.
site.categories.title: Noma ngabe ngumuphi umsebenzi, kunomhlinzeki
site.categories.body: Izigaba eziyinhloko zamasevisi endawo ekuqaleni, kanye nezengeziwe njengoba imakethe ngayinye ikhula.
site.trust.title: Yakhelwe ukuzizwa uphephile ohlangothini lwabo bobabili
site.trust.body: Izibuyekezo ezingempela, imilayezo yangasese, nezilawuli ezigcina omakhelwane elawulweni ledatha yabo.
site.trustItems.0.1: Amazinga angempela avela kubakhelwane bangempela ngemva komsebenzi wonke.
site.trustItems.2.1: Maka noma uvimbe noma yimuphi umsebenzisi noma nini.
site.trustItems.3.1: Susa i-akhawunti yakho nedatha noma nini lapho ukhetha.
site.trustItems.4.1: Abahlinzeki bayalawula ukuthi indawo yabo iboniswa kanjani.
site.waitlist.title: Landa i-SwapSpot namuhla
site.waitlist.body: Bheka abahlinzeki abaseduze mahhala. Sebenzisa iphasi uma usulungele ukuthumela imilayezo, ukucela amakhoteshini noma ukubhukha.
site.waitlist.noSpam: Landa i-app, ubheke abahlinzeki, uqale uma usulungele.
site.download.title: Landa i-SwapSpot ye-iOS noma ye-Android
site.download.body: Bheka abahlinzeki abaseduze mahhala. Sebenzisa iphasi uma usulungele ukuthumela imilayezo, ukucela amakhoteshini noma ukubhukha.
site.footer.tagline: Imakethe yomakhelwane yosizo lwendawo olwethembekile. Yenzelwe imiphakathi yonke e-US.
site.footer.bottom: Thola usizo lwendawo olwethembekile eduze nawe.
site.footer.companyLine: Isebenza ngaphansi kwe-USPROJECT LLC · EIN 83-3989558 · New York, USA
directory.indexMetaDescription: Bheka amakhasi amasevisi omphakathi e-SwapSpot ngesigaba nangemakethe yendawo. Thola ukuhlanza, ukulungisa, ukuthutha, ukufundisa, ukunakekela izilwane, ubuhle, amasevisi obungcweti nokunye.
directory.indexIntro: La makhasi akhiqizwa kumasevisi abahlinzeki ashicilelwe ku-SwapSpot. Asiza amaklayenti athole ukubukwa kwangaphambili kwamasevisi angempela ngedolobha, ikhodi yeposi, indawo, isigaba, intengo, ulimi nezinga.
directory.byCountryBody: Zonke izixhumanisi ezingezansi zivula ikhasi lomphakathi. Uma umhlinzeki eshicilela indawo entsha yokusebenza, ivela lapha ngemva kokuvuselelwa kwekheshi yesayithi.
directory.emptyBody: Uhlu lwakhiwa ngamasevisi abahlinzeki ashicilelwe. Uma kungekho zixhumanisi ezivelayo lapha okwamanje, buya maduze noma uvule i-app ukuze ubheke abahlinzeki abaseduze.
directory.pairMetaDescription: Thola abahlinzeki besigaba: {categoryLower} e-{market}. Qhathanisa ukubukwa kwamasevisi omphakathi, izindawo zokusebenza, amanani, izilimi namazinga ngaphambi kokuvula i-SwapSpot.
directory.pairOgDescription: Bheka amasevisi endawo esigaba: {categoryLower} eduze ne-{market} bese uqhubeka ku-app ye-SwapSpot.
directory.pairSummaryEmpty: I-SwapSpot iyalungisa ukubukwa kwabahlinzeki besigaba: {categoryLower} e-{market}. Vula i-app ukuze ubheke abahlinzeki abaseduze, uqhathanise izindawo zokusebenza futhi ucele amakhoteshini.
directory.pairSummary: Qhathanisa ukubukwa kwamasevisi omphakathi esigaba: {categoryLower} kubahlinzeki bendawo eduze ne-{market}. Sebenzisa i-app uma usulungele ukuthumela umlayezo, ukucela ikhoteshini noma ukubhukha.
directory.popularBody: La masevisi asuka kumaphrofayili abahlinzeki ashicilelwe, hhayi uhlu lwezikhangisi olungashintshi.
directory.areaBody: Amakhasi omphakathi abonisa omakhelwane, amakhodi eposi, amadolobha nerediyasi yesevisi ukuze amaklayenti athole usizo oluseduze ngaphandle kokudalula amakheli angasese.
directory.namesBody: Amasevisi abahlinzeki ahlelwa abe yizihloko ezingasesheka, amagama endawo namakhasi ezigaba ukuze amaklayenti asesha ngemisebenzi angayidinga ngempela.
directory.inAppBody: Iwebhusayithi isiza abantu bathole amasevisi. I-SwapSpot igcina amakhoteshini, imilayezo, ukubhukha, izibuyekezo nezilawuli zokuphepha ngaphakathi kwe-app yeselula.
directory.faqTitle: Indlela leli khasi lomphakathi elisebenza ngayo
directory.pairFaq1Q: Ngingabhukha yini abahlinzeki besigaba: {categoryLower} e-{market} kuleli khasi?
directory.pairFaq1A: Leli khasi lewebhusayithi liwukubukwa komphakathi kokutholwa. Landa i-SwapSpot ukuthumela abahlinzeki imilayezo, ukucela amakhoteshini, ukwabelana ngamakheli aqondile nokuphatha ukubhukha.
directory.pairFaq2A: Cha. I-SwapSpot ibonisa izindawo zokusebenza ezilinganiselwe njengamakhodi eposi, omakhelwane, amadolobha noma irediyasi. Amakheli aqondile asala eyimfihlo futhi angabelwana ekuxoxeni kuphela uma izinhlangothi zombili zilungele.
directory.pairFaq3A: Cha. Abahlinzeki bangadala iphrofayili futhi bashicilele amasevisi ngaphandle kwekhomishani noma imali yephesenti ye-SwapSpot. Amaklayenti akhokhela ukufinyelela uma efuna ukuthumela imilayezo, ukucela amakhoteshini noma ukubhukha.
directory.pairListDescription: Ukubukwa komphakathi kwamasevisi esigaba: {categoryLower} atholakala nge-SwapSpot e-{market}.
directory.cardsEmptyBody: I-SwapSpot ivula amaphrofayili abahlinzeki bendawo ngemakethe. Landa i-app ukuze ubone amasevisi aseduze, uqhathanise amanani futhi uthumele abahlinzeki imilayezo uma usulungele.
directory.cardsBody: Qhathanisa amasevisi, amanani, izindawo, izilimi, amazinga nesipiliyoni sabahlinzeki eduze ne-{market}. Amakheli aqondile nokuxhumana ngqo kuhlala ngaphakathi kwe-SwapSpot.
directory.cardNoDescription: Bona ukubukwa kwale sevisi ku-SwapSpot, bese uvula i-app ukuthumela umlayezo, ucele ikhoteshini noma ubhukhe.
directory.helperDescription: {name} unikeza {services} nge-SwapSpot eduze ne-{markets}. Qhathanisa ukubukwa kwamasevisi omphakathi, amanani, izilimi, amazinga nezindawo zokusebenza ngaphambi kokuvula i-app.
directory.helperDescriptionNoMarket: {name} unikeza {services} nge-SwapSpot. Qhathanisa ukubukwa kwamasevisi omphakathi, amanani, izilimi, amazinga nezindawo zokusebenza ngaphambi kokuvula i-app.
directory.previewBody: Qhathanisa amasevisi lapha, bese uthumela imilayezo ubhukhe ngaphakathi kwe-app.
directory.noCommissionBody: Abahlinzeki bagcina inkokhelo yemisebenzi. I-SwapSpot ayithathi iphesenti noma ikhomishani emsebenzini wabahlinzeki.
directory.servicesBody: Lokhu kuyiwukubukwa kwamasevisi ashicilelwe ku-SwapSpot. Amanani angaba amisiwe, ngehora, aqala ku-, noma iyacelwa kuye ngomsebenzi.
directory.serviceFallback: Vula i-SwapSpot ukubona le sevisi, ucele imininingwane futhi uqinisekise ububanzi ngaphambi kokubhukha.
directory.areasBody: Amakhasi omphakathi abahlinzeki anika izinjini zokusesha namaklayenti umongo owanele: amagama amasevisi, omakhelwane, amadolobha, izindawo ezilinganiselwe nezimpawu zolimi. Imininingwane yokuxhumana eqondile ihlala ngaphakathi kwe-SwapSpot.
directory.continueTitle: Thumela umlayezo, ucele ikhoteshini ubhukhe ngezilawuli zobumfihlo.
directory.helperFaq1A: Vula i-SwapSpot ukuthumela umhlinzeki umlayezo, ucele ikhoteshini, wabelane ngemininingwane eqondile yomsebenzi futhi uphathe ukubhukha ngokuphephile ngaphakathi kwe-app.
directory.helperFaq2A: Cha. Amakhasi omphakathi abonisa izindawo zokusebenza ezilinganiselwe njengomakhelwane, amadolobha, amakhodi eposi noma irediyasi. Amakheli aqondile asala eyimfihlo kuze kube abasebenzisi bewabelana ekuxoxeni.
directory.helperFaq3A: Cha. Abahlinzeki bangashicilela amasevisi ngaphandle kokuthi i-SwapSpot ithathe ikhomishani noma iphesenti ezinkokhelweni zemisebenzi yabo.

pricing.title: Bheka mahhala. Sebenzisa iphasi uma usulungele ukwenza.
pricing.body: Amaklayenti angahlola izigaba aqhathanise abahlinzeki ngaphandle kokukhokha. Iphasi liyadingeka ukuthumela umlayezo, ukucela ikhoteshini noma ukubhukha umhlinzeki.
pricing.freeBody: Bona izigaba, ukubukwa kwabahlinzeki, izindawo zokusebenza nezimpawu eziyisisekelo zokwethembeka ngaphambi kokukhetha iphasi.
pricing.plans.0.name: Iphasi Losuku
pricing.plans.0.note: Ilungele umsebenzi owodwa, usizo oluphuthumayo, noma ukuzama i-SwapSpot.
pricing.plans.1.name: Client Pro
pricing.plans.1.note: Ilungele izidingo ezijwayelekile zasekhaya, zomndeni, zokuqashisa noma zebhizinisi.
pricing.plans.1.features.1: Thumela imilayezo ucele amakhoteshini noma nini
pricing.plans.1.features.2: Inani elingcono ngemva kwezinsuku ezisebenzayo ezi-5
passPrice.seeStore: Bona intengo yamanje ku-App Store noma ku-Google Play
passPrice.referenceNote: Intengo yereferensi. I-App Store noma i-Google Play ibonisa intengo yokugcina.
passPrice.footnote: Intengo yokugcina yasendaweni nezintela kuboniswa yi-App Store noma yi-Google Play ngaphambi kokuthenga.
staticPages.intro: Leli khasi litholakala ngolimi olukhethile. Mayelana nemibuzo yezomthetho noma ye-akhawunti, xhumana nathi ku-hello@swapspot.org.
appPreview.title: Ukubhukha okuphelele, kusuka ekuqaleni kuya ekugcineni
appPreview.mapBody: Abahlinzeki abangu-12 phakathi kwamamayela angu-2, bukhoma.
appPreview.messageA: Sawubona! Ungakwazi ukuhlanza i-flethi enamakamelo okulala ama-2 ngoMgqibelo?
forClients.title: Qeda umsebenzi ngaphandle kokuzingela abantu
forClients.body: Vula i-app, bona ukuthi ngubani oseduze, qhathanisa amaphrofayili angempela, thumelana imilayezo ngaphakathi kwe-SwapSpot, bese ubhukha uma kubonakala kulungile.
forClients.cards.1.1: Bona amaphrofayili, amanani, izibuyekezo, izithombe namasevisi.
forClients.cards.2.1: Buza imibuzo, uqinisekise imininingwane, ugcine amakhoteshini ehlelekile.
forClients.cards.3.1: Sebenzisa izibuyekezo, imibiko, ukuvimba nezilawuli ze-akhawunti uma kudingeka.
cookieConsent.title: Ukukhetha kwakho kobumfihlo
cookieConsent.body: Sisebenzisa amakhukhi e-Google Analytics ukuze siqonde ukuvakashelwa futhi sithuthukise i-SwapSpot. Ungavuma noma wenqabe amakhukhi ezibalo okuzikhethela.
maintenance.text: I-SwapSpot ihambela kumaseva amasha. Cishe ihora elilodwa, ukungena, ukusetha kabusha iphasiwedi nezinguquko ze-akhawunti kungase kungasebenzi. Sicela uzame futhi emuva kwesikhashana.
reset.title: Setha kabusha iphasiwedi yakho
reset.intro: Khetha iphasiwedi entsha, bese ungena ku-app ye-SwapSpot nge-imeyili yakho nephasiwedi entsha.
reset.done: Iphasiwedi yakho ishintshiwe. Vula i-app ye-SwapSpot bese ungena.
reset.invalid: Lesi sixhumanisi sokusetha kabusha asivumelekile noma siphelelwe yisikhathi. Cela esisha ku-app.
reset.openLink: Vula isixhumanisi sokusetha kabusha ku-imeyili yakho ukuze uqhubeke.
reset.unavailable: Ukusetha kabusha iphasiwedi akutholakali kule sayithi okwamanje.
